item.title: Getting Started with OpenTofu by Deploying an Azure VM
item.description: Are you looking at OpenTofu and wondering how much work it is to switch from Terraform? OpenTofu came up recently in a conversation about deployment and automation, and rather than guess, I installed it and tried it against my own lab. It turned out to be a very small change.
